# Unclasp

> Browser-based PDF tools and a separate developer API for PDF password removal.

Unclasp provides a website PDF password remover that requires the current PDF
password, plus supported PDF page, image, metadata, and text utilities. Website
tools are processed locally in the browser and do not have an application
upload fallback. The developer API is a separate service: it receives PDF
uploads and processes them on its server.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/): Product overview, author information, and FAQs.
- [Remove a PDF password](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/pdf-password-remover): Unlock a PDF when you know its current password. This is not password recovery.
- [PDF tools](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/pdf-tools): Available page, image, metadata, and selectable-text operations with their limitations.
- [Developer API documentation](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/docs): HMAC-authenticated API reference and examples. API requests upload PDFs for server-side processing.
- [Privacy policy](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/privacy): File processing and privacy details.
- [Terms of use](https://pdf-fe-kappa.vercel.app/terms): Terms and processing limits.

## Important limitations

- PDF-to-Markdown and PDF comparison operate on selectable text; they do not OCR scanned pages or compare visual layout.
- Edit PDF currently supports adding a text overlay; it does not edit or remove existing page content.
- Password removal requires the existing password.
- The website tools are not substitutes for cryptographic signatures or secure redaction.
